evidence.quote: A community-managed wildlife haven in Tower Hamlets, East London.

findings.value: No music on the calendar. Its listings are workshops, talks and community classes, a weekly family forest school and a Sunday street service.

evidence.quote: Forest Friday is a free, weekly forest school inviting local children and families to explore the wonders of nature right on your doorstep.
